# Thematic breaks and typography {#breaks}

A line of hyphens could be a thematic break, a heading underline or text in 0.1. 0.2 has one break spelling, `***`, so a hyphen run is read by the dash rule alone ([technical rationale](../technical-rationale#reduce-punctuation-collisions), C2-B-159, C2-I-111). Smart quotes follow one opening rule (C2-I-104).

**U-044** <Badge type="tip" text="rewrite" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Hyphen or underscore run

::: compare no-render
```text
para

---

next

___

-----
```
```crv
para

***

next

***

***
```
:::

**U-045** <Badge type="tip" text="rewrite" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Spaced breaks

::: compare no-render
```text
* * *

- - -
```
```crv
***

***
```
:::

**U-046** <Badge type="info" text="none" /> Spaced underscores, stars under an item

::: compare no-render
```text
_ _ _
```
```html
<p>_ _ _</p>
```
:::

**U-071** <Badge type="tip" text="rewrite" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Single opening quote with no closer

::: compare no-render
```text
said 'Bob and left.
```
```crv
said ’Bob and left.
```
:::

**U-190** <Badge type="tip" text="rewrite" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-I-035, `-"` before a hard break writes a closing smart quote, and <code>x{.k title="&#96;"} y</code> reads its backtick as code to the end in 0.1.

::: compare no-render
```text
x{.k title="`"} y
```
```crv
x{.k title=“`"} y`
```
:::

**U-233** <Badge type="tip" text="rewrite" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-I-035 and C2-I-104, `:a:"q"` then `:long-name:'q'` writes `:a:“q”` and `:long-name:‘q’` in 0.1.

::: compare no-render
```text
:a:"q"
:long-name:'q'
```
```crv
:a:“q"
:long-name:‘q'
```
:::

**U-363** <Badge type="tip" text="rewrite" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-I-026 and C2-I-104, a single quote directly behind a braced comment that follows a space: `a {%%}'word`; also `a{%%} 'word`

::: compare no-render
```text
a {%%}'word
```
```crv
a {%%}’word
```
:::

**U-375** <Badge type="tip" text="rewrite" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> An ASCII double quote right after `-` or `/` opens a curly quote in 0.1: `-"q"` gives `-“q”`; 0.2 closes it.

::: compare no-render
```text
a="b"
:"q"
-"q"
/"q"
("q")
```
```crv
a="b"
:"q"
-“q"
/“q"
("q")
```
:::

**U-431** <Badge type="tip" text="rewrite" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> a ----------- b

::: compare no-render
```text
a ----------- b
```
```crv
a ———– b
```
:::
